entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return some shoes.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Terra-Grip Mountain Bike shoes. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
They just don't work. I went for one ride and got blisters. I just want a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear that. A good pair of cycling shoes should be comfortable right from the start, especially when you're dialing in the position of your cleats. Let me just check the return eligibility for this item.
Okay, I see the delivery was made 11 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return, so you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this for you right now.
Whatever. What do I need to do?

I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just package the shoes back in their original box and attach the label. Once our warehouse receives them, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.

And I do see you're a VIP member with us. I sincerely apologize that these shoes weren't the right fit. As a small gesture, I've added a $20 credit to your account for any future purchase. I hope you'll give our gear another try.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
